facts.title: spinach and ricotta gnudi
ingredients: 1 package (10-ounce or 283-gram) frozen chopped spinach, thawed
1/2 cup (50 grams) grated parmesan cheese, plus more to serve
A pinch of freshly grated nutmeg (optional)
4 tablespoons (55 grams) salted butter, plus more if needed
facts.author: Deb Perelman
